availability.cutoff: Keep the frozen preceding US market-close information cutoff; early closes use the actual exchange calendar.
availability.example: For March 3, 2025 with February 28 16:00 New York cutoff, February 28 full-session volume is ineligible. February 27 can qualify only if publication/capture evidence supports that cutoff.
availability.historical: A current download cannot satisfy actual historical capture. A separately declared retrospective availability assumption is not audited point-in-time availability.
availability.lag: Choose the latest fully available paired price/volume activity session. At a same-day close, full-day after-hours volume is unavailable; usually the previous session or earlier is required. Shift the entire activity stencil and matching return direction together.
availability.rule: session_end <= published_at <= first_captured_at <= information_cutoff; all timestamps timezone aware.

control: A separately versioned consolidated regular-session volume asset, with auction boundary rules, may be compared under the same information cutoff. Do not substitute IBKR filtered volume for either consolidated field.
failure: Preserve missing/unknown fields. No inferred x100, fitted multipliers, source splicing, interpolation or relaxation of existing review statuses.

primary.eligibility: Use volume-update sale-condition rules independently of OHLC-update rules. Include auctions/odd lots/off-exchange prints when eligible; apply documented cancellation/correction rules as known by the cutoff.
primary.price: Same activity-date audited raw regular-session close; observed/certified close definition required. Dividend/split-adjusted price is a separate return input.
primary.proxy: raw_regular_close * consolidated_share_volume is a marked activity proxy, not executed dollar turnover or net capital flow.
primary.session: Completed full tape reporting day, including eligible pre/post-market trades under that date's operating calendar. Store actual start/end and America/New_York timezone.
primary.volume: Unadjusted shares, preserved precision, consolidated CTA/UTP volume-eligible trades across participating venues and eligible off-exchange reporting facilities.

scope: Full supported equity-ETF constituent universe when qualified; frozen ten-name sample for source qualification only.
